buttons.label: Throw six slimes
buttons.script: const c=objects.getAll('castle')[0];c.testEntranceOpenAmount=0;const d=c.entranceDoors[0];const slugs=[...objects].filter(o=>o.definition?.object==='LatchSlug'&&o.alive);if(slugs.length){map.gooLaunch?.off();const handle=slugs[0].app.on('update',()=>{if(d.openAmount>0.001)return;handle.off();for(const s of slugs){s.doorTarget=d;console.log('Door slime launch',s.definition.id,s.beginDoorLeap());}});slugs[0].entity.once('destroy',()=>handle.off());map.gooLaunch=handle;}

buttons.label: Throw one slime
buttons.script: const c=objects.getAll('castle')[0];c.testEntranceOpenAmount=0;const d=c.entranceDoors[0];const slugs=[...objects].filter(o=>o.definition?.object==='LatchSlug'&&o.alive).slice(0,1);if(slugs.length){map.gooLaunch?.off();const handle=slugs[0].app.on('update',()=>{if(d.openAmount>0.001)return;handle.off();for(const s of slugs){s.doorTarget=d;console.log('Door slime launch',s.definition.id,s.beginDoorLeap());}});slugs[0].entity.once('destroy',()=>handle.off());map.gooLaunch=handle;}
